about: Each scenario of a page activity other than network and motion - storage, console, page errors, dialogs and navigations - against each capability devharness offers for it. A cell holds what devharness is expected to do and how that stands today: works, gap, unmeasured or n/a. A cell’s basis is code (read from src/) or sequence:<name> (shown by a run), and a cell reads works only on a sequence basis. A scenario’s cell is merged over its carrier’s default, then its kind’s, then the capability’s. A scenario with no control is a case no demo page stages yet. The conditions behind Credit, Compare and Log stand in docs/landscapes/attribution.landscape; motion has its own matrix in examples/motion/matrix.json.

capabilities.name: Seen
capabilities.question: Does devharness register it, and through what?

capabilities.name: Log
capabilities.question: Does it stand in the observation log as an observation, beside requests, frames and motion?

default.note: ObservationKind holds request, frame, storage and motion (observation-log.ts:29)

capabilities.rule: An activity in the log is read by every view, by History ids and by a replay’s comparison; one outside it reaches none of them.

capabilities.name: Credit
capabilities.question: Which step owns it, and on what evidence?

default.note: Credited by the cursor standing when its report arrives, with no root mark from the page

capabilities.rule: Credited to the action at the root of its cause, recorded as it happens. A credit names one action, several, or none, and each row records its basis: the evidence at capture, a shape across the sequence, code read at a file and line, or a person. A cell reads works on root evidence or stronger, or where a claim of the basis its expect names puts it right; a row placed by timing alone reads as a gap.

capabilities.name: Compare
capabilities.question: Does a replay of the same app read as matched, at any pace?
capabilities.rule: Measured on a sequence with no waits between its actions, so a pass cannot rest on the gaps between steps, and compared by the weight each credit’s evidence carries.

capabilities.name: Source
capabilities.question: Which code made it, and what started it?

default.note: The trigger tracker marks motion alone; no write, log call, throw, dialog or navigation carries a maker or a trigger

capabilities.rule: Each row names the function or call site that made it, opened in DevTools by its go-to, and the trigger chain it ran under, as a motion row does.

capabilities.name: Rule
capabilities.question: Can a sequence rule act on it: answer it, refuse it, ignore it or hold it?

rule.note: No rule acts on a page write; refusesWrites acts on HTTP writes at the proxy
